source: **A {0} followed by more of the pattern** requires the rest of the pattern, so {1} matches {2} but no longer matches {3}.
text: **Un {0} suivi du reste du motif** exige le reste du motif : {1} correspond à {2} mais ne correspond plus à {3}.
